areas.checks: Valid/invalid sign-on, user roles, menu routing, return/cancel behavior and session context
Existing/missing keys, displayed fields, validation order, committed changes and unchanged records after rejection
Confirmation and cancellation, payment transaction creation, resulting balances and related record consistency
Decimal precision, signed fields, truncation/rounding, boundary values and leading-zero identifiers
Identical input files and job sequence, accepted/rejected records, account deltas, statements and report totals
Missing records, duplicate keys, interrupted updates, locking and rollback/commit outcomes
Record layouts, EBCDIC conversion, packed decimals, padding and cross-record relationships

steps.title: Pin source and fixtures
steps.detail: Record commit IDs, input-data hashes, compiler/runtime settings and the business date.

steps.title: Capture original behavior first
steps.detail: Save inputs, screen outputs, messages, persisted-state changes, return codes and reports.

steps.title: Reset and replay
steps.detail: Start both systems from equivalent data and run the same ordered actions.

steps.title: Compare business outcomes
steps.detail: Reconcile balances, transaction amounts, relationships and reporting totals, not merely screen appearance.

steps.title: Keep expectations independent
steps.detail: Do not use the converted code to generate its own expected results.

steps.title: Separate parity from corrections
steps.detail: Preserve observed source behavior for the benchmark; record approved defect fixes as separate acceptance criteria.
